algorithm: Require valid explicit new profile and accepted T025 branch + T030 stem prerequisites and separate combined T032 source approval
Calculate selected decade branch/range identically to T025; mapped T030 stem identically using trusted lunar year stem + Dần-relative physical selected branch
Choose built-in table row by exact selected decade heavenly stem; preserve four ordered positions Lộc,Quyền,Khoa,Kỵ

For each position resolve its fixed source canonical star identity against trusted B3 normalized natal stars; only matching canonical known major targets and four known auxiliary targets, never natal Hóa instances or other horoscope stars
Associate each source target with its actual existing physical natal palace ID/branch/function; no relocation of natal stars or decadal functional role rotation
Keep all four ordered transformation association records even when multiple source stars share one palace

productIntegrityGuard.policy: Exactly one coherent natal instance per selected source identity; a missing/duplicated/conflicting selected target or invalid layout withholds all four associations as one incomplete result, with no guessed first palace
productIntegrityGuard.scope: This stricter product integrity guard is not an upstream uniqueness theorem. Upstream membership can be true in more than one malformed palace.

closedStates: Missing opt-in/old profile has no new transformation output
Invalid request rejected by existing strict option contract; valid nominalAge range1..125 unchanged
Before first/after twelfth mapped period has no transformations and no childhood fallback
Any failed source decision/binding, invalid trusted metadata, unmapped selected period, missing/duplicate/contradictory selected target withholds all transformation associations
explicitExclusions: No source approval inherited from T025/T030 alone
No natal formula/table/Hóa insertion or natal association edits
No custom mutagen table, global/context override acceptance, upstream calendar equivalence, date/age derivation or from rerooting
No yearly/monthly/daily/hourly/age transforms; no moving horoscope stars, flies/directions/chains or decadal role projection
No classical generic tu_hoa_han activation, defaults/school change or SQLite migration
No outcome prose, auspicious/adverse scoring, predictions, public interpretation or production release
sourceFacts: FunctionalAstrolabe selects an inclusive actual decadal range and reads its heavenlyStem, then calls getMutagensByHeavenlyStem; its separate childhood fallback is explicitly excluded by existing period scope
decadalList independently passes each decadal.heavenlyStem, not target-year or birthyear stem

getTargetMutagens prefers configured row when truthy, otherwise fixed heavenlyStems row. Config arrays may differ and are not validated as four entries by upstream resolveConfig, so arbitraryconfig equivalence is explicitly excluded
Context bindContext captures creation-time config/language and wraps functional calls; later global reset does not retroactively redefine existing source objects
MUTAGEN order is sihuaLu,sihuaQuan,sihuaKe,sihuaJi; vi labels lack Hóa prefix, so Hóa labels are explicit B3 presentation mapping
hasHoroscopeMutagen maps scope-relative requested palace name to physical index and reads astrolabe natal majorStars and minorStars; no insertion of four new stars occurs in this membership operation

Source function returns boolean membership, including false for origin/negative palace index. Product emits inverse physical associations on trusted B3 chart, not a claim of full source boolean API or natal placement equivalence
kot reverses localized names with explicit ambiguity aliases; none of15selected keys uses listed colliding alias. Fixed Vietnamese target mapping avoids uncontrolled locale execution

outputContract.mutagenPlacement: supported only all four associations coherent and evidence accepted; not_applied otherwise
outputContract.mutagens: Exactly4 ordered records on supported, [] closed
outputContract.integrityFailure: Fail closed all associations, selected stem and branch; no partial or stale association retained
outputContract.legacyProfiles: Exact unchanged shape/behavior, no new fields

tableReuseGuard: Runtime may read existing B3 tuHoaMap.json without editing it; new T032 binding must deeply and strictly compare entire10-row40-cell content against approved immutable compiled source snapshot. That comparison does not approve or alter existing natal runtime.

fixtureClassificationEvidence.class: source-comparative table/stem + engineering observed B3 identity/physical metadata, not natal placement proof
